text: ふふ　あたし　じしん　あるわよ　あなたの　てに　おえるかな？

structure.jp: あたし　じしん　あるわよ
あなたの　てに　おえるかな？
structure.en: I wonder if you can handle me?

patterns.name: 〜かな
patterns.explanation: かな at the end means 'I wonder if', here said teasingly. おえるかな = 'I wonder if you can manage'.

patterns.name: 〜てにおえる
patterns.explanation: てにおえる is a set phrase, literally 'can be carried in the hand', meaning something is within your power to deal with. あなたの　てに　おえる = 'you can handle it'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end is a soft, feminine way to state something, and よ after it presses the point on the listener. あるわよ = 'I do have it, you know'.
